# Appeal Edge

> Independent Amazon seller suspension appeal consultancy led by the expert who pioneered the industry in 2014. Cases are reviewed individually and pricing is provided after that review, not published as a fixed rate.

## Services
- [Amazon Suspension Appeal Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-appeal-service/): case review, root cause diagnosis, and a case specific Plan of Action written for the actual suspension type
- [Plan of Action Writing Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-plan-of-action-writing-service/): for sellers who already know their violation type and need the document itself written
- [IP Complaint Removal Service](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-ip-complaint-removal-service/): trademark, copyright, and counterfeit complaint appeals
- [Appeal Service for India Based Sellers](https://www.appeal-edge.com/amazon-appeal-service-india/): the same process, communicated over WhatsApp and email in India time zones
- Account health guidance to help prevent future suspensions

## Suspension Types Covered
- Inauthentic and counterfeit complaints
- Performance metrics: Order Defect Rate, Late Shipment Rate, Valid Tracking Rate
- Intellectual property, trademark, and copyright complaints
- Related account suspensions
- Listing policy violations and restricted category issues
- Review manipulation suspicions
- Dropshipping policy violations
- Used sold as new and condition complaints

## How a case is handled
- Step 1: Review the suspension notice and identify the actual violation type and root cause
- Step 2: Cross reference the case against Amazon's current policy requirements
- Step 3: Draft a case specific Plan of Action naming the root cause, the corrective action already taken, and the preventive measures going forward
- Step 4: Check the draft for generic language, vague claims, and missing specifics before submission

## Key Facts
- [Jeff Goldin](https://www.appeal-edge.com/experts/jeff-goldin/), advisor to Appeal Edge, founded the first Amazon appeal and reinstatement firm in 2014 and has more than 25 years of Amazon experience across 7 marketplaces
- Every case is reviewed and assigned to the specialist who fits it. The most complex cases are personally handled by the lead expert
- Pricing is not published. Case review is free, and pricing is discussed only after the case is reviewed
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon.com, Inc.
- Independent consultancy, not a law firm
